Overview

Malindi is a city in Kilifi with a population of 118,000. A coastal resort town in southeastern Kenya, known for its beautiful beaches, coral reefs, and historic Portuguese architecture. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 290 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 20.0.
